# Lane — Arabic-English Lexicon, selected online entries

## Identity, edition and scope

Edward William Lane’s Arabic-English Lexicon is consulted through the named Lane entry transcriptions at laneslexicon.com. Selection is this online witness; no print volume/page or edition date is invented. Two complete entries were read. Their cited lexicographers remain mediated witnesses; their proposed historical derivations and examples were not independently collated. The root labels distinguish حسب from the separate حصو/حصى family.

## Passages and excerpts

<a id="lane-arabic-english-lexicon-online-p001"></a>
### lane-arabic-english-lexicon-online-p001 — Ḥisāb

**Paraphrase:** The entry includes counting and computation, a presented account, final judgment, and recounting qualities or deeds. These are differentiated uses of the noun.

**Locator:** s.v. حِسَابٌ, entry n7949, complete definition, especially opening and numbered sense 2.

**Provenance:** Lane online transcription, lane-hisab.html. Read 2026-09-08 against the identified online witness.

**Source relation:** Paraphrased.

**Status:** paraphrase-ready; no quotation admitted.

**Use boundary:** Supports the reckoning range; not an etymology of English account or a claim that all religious enumeration uses this root.

<a id="lane-arabic-english-lexicon-online-p002"></a>
### lane-arabic-english-lexicon-online-p002 — Iḥṣāʾ and remembering

**Paraphrase:** The separate form-IV entry includes enumeration, registration, memory and comprehensive knowledge.

**Locator:** s.v. احصاهُ, root حصو, form IV; complete definition, opening and numbered senses 2–4.

**Provenance:** Lane online transcription, lane-ahsa.html. Read 2026-09-08 against the identified online witness.

**Source relation:** Paraphrased.

**Status:** paraphrase-ready; no quotation admitted.

**Use boundary:** Distinguishes the hadith verb aḥṣāhā from ḥisāb. The dictionary’s pebble explanations remain attributed lexicographic proposals, not newly verified ancient practices.
